sentences.en: His career as a journalist was full of distinguished achievements.
sentences.zh: 他作为一名记者的职业生涯充满了卓越的成就。

sentences.en: The general cut a distinguished figure in his dress uniform.
sentences.zh: 将军身着礼服军装显得格外引人注目。

sentences.en: The rest of the show was not particularly distinguished.
sentences.zh: 剩下的节目并没有特别突出的地方。
